_sourceRefs: PyX12 (azoner/pyx12) 837.5010.X222.A1.xml — downloaded and read directly, structural skeleton extracted via a Python XML-parser script (not AI-summarized) to avoid the hallucination risk a prior round hit on a large fetched file, cross-checked line-by-line against the raw XML for every loop/segment. HEADER/DETAIL/FOOTER (PyX12's own Table 1/2/3 wrapper artifacts, not real X12 loops) are flattened away exactly as 835's own header/loops/trailer split already established: BHT (from HEADER) folds into headerSegmentIds alongside ST; 1000A/1000B (from HEADER) and 2000A (from DETAIL) become top-level Loops siblings; FOOTER is empty (usage=N) for 837P, nothing to model.

2000B/2000C's own {loopRef: '2300-claim'} entries are the Fix 3 shared-loop-template mechanism (edi/schema_loader.go's resolveLoopRefs) — see loops/2300-claim.json's own _sourceRefs for the full duplication-avoidance rationale.
TA1 deliberately NOT modeled, same reasoning as 835/999's own precedent (receiver-side interchange acknowledgment, not part of this transaction set's own ST...SE payload).

stTransactionSetId is '837': 837P and 837I are NOT distinguishable by ST01 alone (both are literally the string '837') — GS08 (versionReleaseIndustryCode, REQUIRED in every real GS segment, unlike ST03 which many trading partners leave blank) is the real disambiguator. See CLAUDE.md's EDI Phase 2 section and edi/loop_engine.go's own composite-lookup comment.
